title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.31483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.

translated_title: 训练小型语言模型实现可迁移的工具选择
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型智能体需要在一万多个工具的语料库上运行，为复杂的多步用户指令选择合适的工具成为一个核心瓶颈。工具描述无法全部放入上下文中，而基于相关性的检索器只能对工具进行排序，并不知道哪些工具是实际需要的。最近的工作转而利用诸如 Claude 或 ChatGPT 等专有商业大语言模型来驱动检索器，分解用户指令并从检索到的候选工具中进行选择。我们证明，可以通过强化学习训练一个小型开源模型来执行相同的功能。在 ToolBench 上，使用我们的方案进行后训练的 Qwen3-8B 模型优于 Llama-4-Maverick（402B）。此外，训练好的模型可以直接迁移到不同的检索器，并能泛化到不同领域的新工具语料库。
tldr: 本文通过强化学习训练8B小模型完成工具选择任务，性能超越402B的Llama-4-Maverick，并可直接迁移至不同检索器和跨领域的新工具语料库。
en_tdlr: A reinforcement learning-trained 8B open model matches proprietary LLMs in tool selection, outperforming the 402B Llama-4-Maverick while transferring directly to different retrievers and generalizing to new tool corpora across domains.
